entries.text: **ClickHouse, StarRocks and TPC-DS runner rewrites now run through the bundled SQLGlot runtime.** `ClickHouseQueryTransformer`, the StarRocks execute-time regexes and scanner, the ClickHouse Q10/Q35 overrides and the TPC-DS interval and Q58 regexes are deleted. ClickHouse execution calls `apply_rewrite` (`benchbox.platforms.clickhouse.query_rewrites`), StarRocks execution calls `add_derived_table_aliases`, and TPC-DS uses `correlated_exists_to_in` and `qualify_order_by_columns`. String literals are no longer edited, `(x + 0.0)` is cast to `Decimal(15, 2)`, an existing `SETTINGS` clause is replaced, JOIN-derived and nested StarRocks subqueries receive aliases, and a double-quoted StarRocks token keeps its string-literal reading. Unparseable SQL still fails before reaching the engine. Q58 on BigQuery, Spark, Databricks and SingleStore now qualifies `item_id` in `ORDER BY`; published Q58 results on those targets ran the ambiguous form. ClickHouse query text is unchanged for 745 of 749 benchmark queries (the rest gain the session setting) and published ClickHouse results do not change.
